Definition

A quartic with 45 nodes; Heinrich Burkhardt, 1891. The 45-nodal object is a THREEFOLD in P^4 (y0^4 - y0(y1^3+..+y4^3) + 3 y1 y2 y3 y4 = 0), so any 3D picture is a section: THE SHIPPED ROW IS THE y0 = (y1+y2+y3+y4)/4 HYPERPLANE SECTION, chosen because it contains all seven of the threefold's real rational nodes; four are affine in the y4 = 1 chart and are verified exactly by the self-test.
